text_block_list.text:
Huh. A stamina-restoring item dropped.
Might as
well use it since I got time to
spare.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, for crying out loud. Would it kill you
to use
your inside voice once in a while?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Sorry, my bad! But, but, but—you
know
what? Something really cool just
happened!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ack! The hell are you crying for?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I can't believe you put your phone away in the middle of a game to listen to me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo touched! I can't believe you've
gotten
this used to chatting with people!
I'm so proud of
youuu!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: No, that's not... Ugh, forget it!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Lately, it's been easier talking with
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by this, I decide to discuss
her
training regimen together with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'll just listen today, so say whatever you
want.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Why are you freaking out? All I said is
that I'd
listen!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин seems awfully
embarrassed for
some reason.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
